dataset: SparrKULee RDR V3.1 public derivatives; CC-BY-NC-4.0 internal noncommercial research

scope.records: all S02 READY records of selected subjects

input: publisher preprocessed 64-channel EEG; no extra filtering or PCA
target: publisher envelope averaged over feature axis; common overlap at publisher story origin
lag_definition: y_envelope[t] predicted from EEG[t + lag_samples]; future EEG 0..500 ms; offline decoder
null_definition: refit separately using EEG[t+832+lag] to envelope[t]; noncircular; within record
common_time_support: t=0..common_n-832-32-1 for ALL conditions and models; shared finite mask over target and all matched/null TRF predictors
split: copy S02 per-subject canonical source-family split exactly; no held-out-subject claim
normalization: train-only mean/std per design column and target; no refit on validation or test

ridge.objective: mean squared error + alpha * squared L2 weights; intercept via train centering
ridge.selection: validation mean per-record Pearson r; tie chooses first/smallest alpha; no train+val refit

example: first test record of first selected subject, first 20 seconds of valid support; never selected by performance
failure_policy: record read/shape/nonfinite/insufficient-split failures; no replacement or scope expansion; negative results retained
validation: synthetic indexing/ridge/metric tests; family disjointness; same sample counts; separate first-subject rerun and table comparison
